geometryRulesAndLimits.median: Two-way non-elevated trunk/primary/secondary roads of at least 10.5 m width receive inferred center medians, with junction and periodic U-turn gaps. One-way major carriageways use a side median rule instead. These rules do not prove a continuous wall at the suggested point.
geometryRulesAndLimits.curb: Non-elevated major-road footpaths/curbs depend on road class, width, quality setting and junction trimming. Soft curb behavior must be distinguished from a hard median/parapet.
geometryRulesAndLimits.parapet: Elevated segments generate deck geometry; solid parapets skip joins and ramp-foot sections below 1.7 m. Suggestions prefer a segment at least 4 m high within 1 km when available; otherwise the nearest segment with both endpoints at least 1.7 m.
geometryRulesAndLimits.camera: Only a natural bus/truck sightline crossing with before/during/after captures can exercise PT-004. A static source bounding box or ordinary traffic encounter is not a completed camera retest.
geometryRulesAndLimits.landmark: Patancheru/Shamshabad/Ghatkesar do not reproduce the historical Mecca or Sudarshan starting trajectory. General recovery may be sampled without claiming PT-003/PT-010 exact reproduction.

pickupEligibilityCoverage.method: Invoked current eligiblePickup as a pure function after an in-memory esbuild bundle; write:false. No browser/game state, output files or test/source mutation.
pickupEligibilityCoverage.interpretation: Missing category means the category filter does not establish that these legacy records are actual kitchens. Police-named records expose the known PT-012 coverage gap; other market/bus-stand names are review candidates, not newly confirmed non-food businesses. Nearest source records do not predict the next randomized offer.
pickupEligibilityCoverage.browserLimit: No new offer observed by this analyst. Do not count source eligibility as a fresh PT-012 reproduction or bind a generic offer label to a source ID without evidence.

highValueScenarios: A bounded complete legitimate pickup and handover through visible E prompts takes priority over forced scenario hunting. Late/zero-heat/zero-slice orders still allow handover; record actual reward/progress.
Sample map Close and, if using flight, distinguish the known focused-minimap Space conflict from vehicle flight handling.
If a median or elevated barrier occurs naturally along the accepted route, save segment/location and before/contact/after views while grounded.
Count only actual new collections/handovers this round; preserve prior paused workflows and do not aggregate resumed orders again.
claimLimit: No real-world street/shop accuracy, current business operation or entire-area coverage is established by these mapped opportunities or source-only checks.
